title: Puppet Master Backup and Restore System contracts
description: Plans-only discriminated v2 contracts for independently recoverable Project and Catalog repositories, multi-destination encrypted backup, eleven destination families, RecoverySet/Recovery Kit custody, scheduling/retention, browse/retrieve, four mutating restore modes, migrations, health projections, and truthful evidence. These shapes are not runtime backup or recovery proof.

recovery_kit_delivery_session.title: RecoveryKitDeliverySession
recovery_kit_delivery_session.description: Public control-plane record for a protected human-only no-store session. Recovery credential bytes are deliberately not representable here.

backup_health_projection.title: BackupHealthProjection
backup_health_projection.description: Cached, read-only Doctor/Settings projection; never a mutation or recovery-key surface.

backup_restore_command_request.title: BackupRestoreCommandRequest
backup_restore_command_request.description: One owner-DRY request envelope for the exact 41 canonical backup/restore commands. Conditional branches add action-specific repository, destination, snapshot, RecoverySet, currentness, preview, protected-channel, lease, confirmation, and target requirements.
